changes.to: Checked 2026-11-28: Toyota Times (Toyota Motor Corporation) confirms CUE7 as the newest CUE model, debuted 2026-04-12 at TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO, a full model change with court movement and dribbling added. Toyota's own pages publish no spec table, so no maker-stated height or weight exists; the 219 cm / 74 kg figures come from Toyota Alvark Tokyo's signing release (the club's roster profile, not a Toyota Motor spec sheet), and B.League coverage reports the mass dropping from CUE6's 120 kg to 74 kg. Because the numbers rest on a club announcement rather than a maker spec source, the record is kept as unconfirmed (owner decision 2026-11-28) with those figures retained and attributed here. DoF, speed, battery and price are not published. Research/demonstration platform, not a product for sale.
Toyota's seventh-generation AI basketball humanoid: a 2.19 m biped that walks, dribbles and shoots, debuted at a Toyota Alvark Tokyo home game in April 2026.
